title: YieldCalibrationLog
description: Append-per-cycle empirical record of the FR1 cycle-yield model. Lives at <vault>/_pipeline/yield-calibration.json. Re-tuned against in 0.7.2.

cycle.description: Cycle number this record was emitted for.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the cycle's CG-001 evaluation.

cadence_bucket.description: Time-since-last-cycle bucket. Cold start maps to 'monthly'.

cadence_factor.description: Multiplier from cycle_yield.cadence_factor for the bucket.

coverage_bucket.description: met/target coverage ratio bucket across coverage-targets categories.

coverage_factor.description: Multiplier from cycle_yield.coverage_factor for the bucket.

target.description: clamp(ceil(base * cadence_factor * coverage_factor), min_floor, max_ceiling); 0 when the vault is fully covered (no-remaining-work short-circuit).
